package postgres

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestMigration019BindsUnifiedCoordinatorIdentityAndFailsClosedDown(t *testing.T) {
	_, current, _, ok := runtime.Caller(0)
	require.True(t, ok)
	root := filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(current), "../../../../"))
	up, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "db/migrations/019_teacher_onboarding_unified_coordinator.up.sql"))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	down, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "db/migrations/019_teacher_onboarding_unified_coordinator.down.sql"))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	for _, required := range []string{
		"teacher_onboarding_turn_job_event_fk", "FOREIGN KEY (teacher_job_id, source_event_id) REFERENCES teacher_dialog_job(teacher_job_id, event_id)",
		"teacher_onboarding_turn_interaction_receipt_fk", "FOREIGN KEY (interaction_id, action_receipt_id) REFERENCES teacher_onboarding_interaction(interaction_id, reserved_action_receipt_id)",
		"teacher_onboarding_interaction_one_open_dialog", "teacher_onboarding_interaction_action_receipt_fk",
		"coordinator_mode IN ('legacy', 'onboarding_action', 'onboarding_text')", "response_assistant_ui_digest",
		"teacher_dialog_turn_outcome_proof_fk", "CHECK ((student_effect_state = 'no_effect') = (no_effect_proof_id IS NOT NULL))",
		"CHECK ((stage = 'failed_no_effect') OR recoverable_outcome_id IS NULL)",
		"CHECK ((stage <> 'delivered') OR (student_effect_state IN ('not_attempted', 'accepted', 'no_effect')))",
	} {
		require.Contains(t, string(up), required)
	}
	for _, required := range []string{"coordinator_mode <> 'legacy'", "source_message_version IS NOT NULL", "reply_to_message_id IS NOT NULL", "response_assistant_ui_digest IS NOT NULL"} {
		require.Contains(t, string(down), required)
	}
	for _, required := range []string{
		"DROP CONSTRAINT teacher_onboarding_turn_interaction_receipt_fk",
		"DROP CONSTRAINT teacher_onboarding_turn_job_event_fk",
		"DROP CONSTRAINT teacher_onboarding_interaction_action_receipt_fk",
		"DROP CONSTRAINT teacher_onboarding_interaction_reserved_job_fk",
	} {
		require.Contains(t, string(down), required)
	}
	require.Less(t, strings.Index(string(down), "teacher_onboarding_turn_interaction_receipt_fk"), strings.Index(string(down), "DROP TABLE teacher_onboarding_turn"))
	require.Less(t, strings.Index(string(down), "teacher_onboarding_interaction_action_receipt_fk"), strings.Index(string(down), "DROP TABLE teacher_onboarding_interaction"))
	require.NotContains(t, string(down), "DROP CONSTRAINT teacher_dialog_job_proof_fk", "017 integrity remains until 017 down")
	require.NotContains(t, string(down), "DROP CONSTRAINT teacher_dialog_job_outcome_fk", "017 integrity remains until 017 down")
	require.Contains(t, string(down), "DROP CONSTRAINT teacher_dialog_turn_outcome_proof_fk")
	require.False(t, strings.Contains(string(up), "ON DELETE CASCADE"))
}
